SELECT 
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip,
    SUM(CASE WHEN days_diff <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN days_diff > 30 AND days_diff <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN days_diff > 60 AND days_diff <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN days_diff > 90 AND days_diff <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(CASE WHEN days_diff > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ss.ss_store_sk,
        ss.s_store_name,
        ss.s_company_id,
        ss.s_street_number,
        ss.s_street_name,
        ss.s_street_type,
        ss.s_suite_number,
        ss.s_city,
        ss.s_county,
        ss.s_state,
        ss.s_zip,
        (sr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk) AS days_diff
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk WHERE d2.d_year = 2001 AND d2.d_moy = 8
) AS date_diffs
JOIN store s ON date_diffs.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
GROUP BY 
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip
ORDER BY 
    s_store_name,
    s_company_id,
    s_street_number,
    s_street_name,
    s_street_type,
    s_suite_number,
    s_city,
    s_county,
    s_state,
    s_zip
LIMIT 100
